     2	 * Core annotation builders for `ToolOutcome` (SPEC v6.1 D5).
     3	 *
     4	 * Each core append of today becomes one annotation with `owner: "core"`.
     5	 * The `text` and the `join` hold the exact bytes of today, so
     6	 * `finalizeOutcome(lift + annotations).text` equals today's `content`.
     7	 *
     8	 * D5 order (append order in the tool round):
     9	 * 1. `output-truncated` (clamp, at the lift)
    10	 * 2. `output-streak` (built-in path only)
    11	 * 3. `diagnostics` (tool.didInvoke notes)
    12	 * 4. `raw-output` (blob footer)
    13	 * 5. `output-preview` (rule V: counted on the finalize prefix)
    14	 * 6. `policy` (rule P: one annotation per clean line, join `"\n"`)
    15	 * 7. `mode-active` (`joinWhenEmpty: false`)
    16	 *
    17	 * One-value rule (DECISIONS D-B option 2, D-A gate): each builder takes ONE
    18	 * source value. A kind spec renders the `text` and makes the `attrs` from
    19	 * that same value. A builder takes no text and no attrs as input, and the
    20	 * result is deep-frozen. {@link buildCoreAnnotation} accepts only the frozen
    21	 * specs of this module (review S3). So the text and the attrs cannot disagree.
    22	 *
    23	 * Pure functions, except that the text kinds call the synthetic text
    24	 * resolver (the providers are pure in M1). No I/O, no clock, no config.
    25	 * The kind labels are names only in M1 (D5). Core registers no kind.
    26	 *
    27	 * @module loops/tool-outcome-annotations
    28	 */
